artifacts.summary: Confirms modules/home/services/sapience.nix is the live module; finds Gap 1 (tokenFile) needs only secrets wiring (with a quoted-string-vs-path-literal hazard flagged); finds Gap 2 (sourceDirs) already satisfies option (b)'s wording in the option description, leaving (a) vs (b) open for planning; finds Gap 3's premise is based on the non-live packages/sapience-flake fork (the live module has no WSL/linger code at all), confirms users.users.<name>.linger exists on the pinned nixos-26.05 channel, and flags a sudo-denial constraint on verifying Acceptance Criterion 4.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 144 --plan to produce an implementation plan that resolves the Gap 2 (a)/(b) choice and the Gap 3 WSL-notice-porting choice explicitly, wires tokenFile via a new sops secret, and sets users.users.${username}.linger = true in modules/system/users.nix.
